# ferentin_llm_provider (Resource)

A tenant binding between an LLM provider (catalog entry — see `data "ferentin_llm_provider"`) and the credentials / configuration the platform uses to reach it. Multiple instances per provider are allowed (e.g., per-region, per-environment).

## Import

Existing instances can be imported using `<tenant_id>/<instance_id>` (or `<instance_id>` alone when the provider's default `tenant_id` matches):

```
terraform import ferentin_llm_provider.example <tenant_id>/<instance_id>
```

After import, set `api_key` (and any other WriteOnly attrs) and bump the `*_wo_version` companions to push the secret on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the Anthropic catalog entry by slug — gives a typo-safe handle
# we can reference downstream.
data "ferentin_llm_provider" "anthropic" {
  slug = "anthropic"
}

resource "ferentin_llm_provider" "anthropic_prod_us" {
  provider_type = data.ferentin_llm_provider.anthropic.slug
  instance_name = "anthropic-prod-us"
  display_name  = "Anthropic Production (US)"
  description   = "Primary US-region Anthropic credentials"

  # Sensitive — never appears in plan/apply output. In production, source
  # from a vault: api_key = data.vault_kv_secret_v2.anthropic.data["api_key"]
  api_key   = var.anthropic_api_key
  auth_type = "api_key"

  enabled  = true
  priority = 100
}

variable "anthropic_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

output "anthropic_instance_id" {
  value = ferentin_llm_provider.anthropic_prod_us.instance_id
}

# --- Pinning a single model via model_constraints -----------------------
# Common pattern in production: a BYOK key with scope limited to one model
# upstream, mirrored by an allowlist on the Ferentin side so runtime
# requests for any other model are denied before they leave the platform.

resource "ferentin_llm_provider" "openai_gpt55_only" {
  provider_type = "openai"
  instance_name = "openai-gpt55-only"
  display_name  = "OpenAI (GPT-5.5 only)"

  api_key   = var.openai_api_key
  auth_type = "API_KEY"

  enabled  = true
  priority = 100

  model_constraints = {
    mode   = "allowlist"
    models = ["gpt-5.5"]
  }
}

variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_name` (String) Human-readable per-instance name (e.g. `anthropic-prod-us`).
- `provider_type` (String) Catalog slug of the LLM provider (`anthropic`, `openai`, `google-vertex`, …). Pull from `data "ferentin_llm_provider"`. Immutable post-create.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Bearer API key for the provider. **WriteOnly** (Terraform 1.11+) — the value flows through to the provider during apply but never enters Terraform state. The server stores an encrypted form; the wire response only exposes `api_key_configured`. Bump `api_key_wo_version` to force a re-send when the upstream secret rotates.
- `api_key_wo_version` (Number) Companion to write-only `api_key`. Bump this integer to force the provider to re-send the (potentially changed) `api_key` on the next apply.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication method for this provider. Allowed values vary per provider type; common: `api_key`, `oauth2_client_credentials`, `aws_iam_role`, `gcp_service_account`.
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region (Bedrock / IAM flows).
- `credentials` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Free-form credentials blob for auth types that aren't a single API key (e.g. GCP service-account JSON). **WriteOnly** — flows through but never enters state. Bump `credentials_wo_version` to force a re-send.
- `credentials_wo_version` (Number) Companion to write-only `credentials`. Bump to force re-send.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in the admin console.
- `enabled` (Boolean) When false, the instance is registered but not used for routing. Default `true`.
- `external_id` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) External ID for cross-account IAM assumption. **WriteOnly** — flows through but never enters state. Bump `external_id_wo_version` to force a re-send.
- `external_id_wo_version` (Number) Companion to write-only `external_id`. Bump to force re-send.
- `health_check_url` (String) Optional custom health-check URL.
- `impersonate_service_account_email` (String) GCP service-account email for impersonation (Vertex AI flows).
- `model_constraints` (Attributes) Restrict which catalog models this instance exposes to runtime requests. Pair `mode = "allowlist"` with an explicit `models` list to deny requests for any model not in the set — the most common pattern when an instance should pin to a single OpenAI / Anthropic model (e.g. `gpt-5.5`, `claude-sonnet-4`). Persisted on the platform as `provider_config.model_constraints` (JSONB); echoed back on Read so drift detection works. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_constraints))
- `priority` (Number) Routing priority (lower is higher-priority).
- `role_arn` (String) AWS IAM role ARN to assume.
- `session_duration_minutes` (Number) STS session duration in minutes (IAM flows).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID. Defaults to provider-level `tenant_id`; immutable per-instance.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_configured` (Boolean) True when an API key has been set on this instance. The value itself is never returned.
- `available_for_routing` (Boolean) Whether the instance is currently eligible for routing.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of creation.
- `created_by` (String) Principal that created the instance.
- `health_status` (String) Runtime health status from the most recent check.
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource ID `<tenant_id>/<instance_id>`.
- `instance_id` (String) Server-generated UUID for this instance.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Provenance of the most recent writer; diverges from `managed_by` when an out-of-band writer edits the resource — the drift signal per platform #651.
- `managed_by` (String) Provenance label of the original creator (platform #651). Immutable.
- `managed_by_client_id` (String) OAuth2 client_id of the original creator.
- `managed_by_module` (String) Module label the creator passed via `X-Ferentin-Managed-By-Module`.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version (platform #649) for If-Match.

<a id="nestedatt--model_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model_constraints`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Set to `"allowlist"` and provide `models`. The platform accepts other modes for advanced use cases but `allowlist` is the supported shape for the Terraform provider.

Optional:

- `models` (List of String) Model IDs that this instance is permitted to serve. E.g. `["gpt-5.5"]` to pin a single model, or `["gpt-5.5", "gpt-4o"]` to allow a small set.
